def compute_ranks(vals):
    n = len(vals)
    indexed = sorted(list(enumerate(vals)), key=lambda x: x[1])
    ranks = [0.0] * n
    i = 0

    n = len(vals)
    indexed = sorted(enumerate(vals), key=lambda x: x[1])
    ranks = [0.0] * n
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and indexed[j][1] == indexed[i][1]:
            j += 1
        # ranks are 1-based, average of occupied ranks (i+1 to j)
        avg_rank = (i + 1 + j) / 2.0
        for k in range(i, j):
            ranks[indexed[k][0]] = avg_rank
        i = j
    return ranks
